name: Hida-Kisogawa Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Hida mountains edge and the Kisogawa river gorge at the Gifu-Aichi border, with Enakyo cliffs and riverside scenery.
notes: Managed by Gifu/Aichi. The Enakyo gorge walkway and the Iwamura castle town sit in the park.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.description: 岐阜・愛知県境に広がる国定公園で、飛騨山脈の辺縁部と木曽川渓谷、恵那峡の断崖絶壁と川沿いの景観を有します。
